stem: The dugong is a marine mammal. Outside Palawan, which department has jurisdiction over the dugong under Section 4 of RA 9147?
choices: Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG)
Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR)
answer: Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR)
hints: Section 4 splits wildlife between two departments. Most sea animals go to one of them, but the law names an exception.
Read Section 4: one department covers "all terrestrial plant and animal species, all turtles and tortoises and wetland species," and its list ends with the dugong.
The other department covers "all marine mammals, except dugong." Use the word "except" to decide which department keeps the dugong.

solution.methodName: Name who is responsible, then check the exact role

steps.action: Recall Section 4 of RA 9147. The DENR has jurisdiction over "all terrestrial plant and animal species, all turtles and tortoises and wetland species, including but not limited to crocodiles, waterbirds and all amphibians and dugong."
steps.why: Terrestrial means living on land. Jurisdiction means the power to regulate and protect.

steps.action: Recall the DA's list: "all aquatic resources including but not limited to all fishes, aquatic plants, invertebrates and all marine mammals, except dugong."
steps.why: The word "except" takes the dugong out of the DA's list, even though it is a marine mammal.

steps.action: Note the Palawan rule: there, this jurisdiction is vested in the Palawan Council for Sustainable Development. The question says outside Palawan, so that rule does not apply.
The answer is the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR).

trapNotes.Department of Agriculture (DA): The DA covers marine mammals, but Section 4 says "except dugong." The dugong is on the DENR's list.
trapNotes.Department of Science and Technology (DO: Section 4 gives wildlife jurisdiction only to the DENR and the DA, not the DOST.
trapNotes.Department of the Interior and Local Gov: Section 4 gives wildlife jurisdiction only to the DENR and the DA, not the DILG.
